description: Client-side JavaScript code defining Vue.js components and application logic for managing CORS policies in an admin interface.

methods.name: addOption
methods.description: Adds a new option to the options list if it is not a duplicate.

methods.name: deleteOption
methods.description: Removes an option from the options list.

methods.name: newPolicy
methods.description: Creates a new default policy object.

methods.name: editPolicy
methods.description: Sets the selected policy for editing.

methods.name: deletePolicy
methods.description: Removes a policy from the list.

methods.name: updatePolicy
methods.description: Updates or adds a policy in the list.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes policies to a form field and submits the form.

methods.name: searchBox
methods.description: Implements search filtering and navigation in the admin interface.
